parameters.name: DeleteAfterQuery
parameters.description:
Whether deletion depends on having already obtained relevant data from the corresponding authentication process.

- Y: Required. To successfully delete the related data, you must have obtained the processing result through the DescribeFaceVerify interface.
- N: Not required (default). For pure server-side API integration, you can directly pass N.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth delete-face-verify-result --certify-id shae18209d29ce4e8ba252caae98ab15 --delete-after-query Y --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth DeleteFaceVerifyResult --region cn-hangzhou --CertifyId shae18209d29ce4e8ba252caae98ab15 --DeleteAfterQuery Y
